reference_policy: CHM13 excluded from pooled discovery, evaluated separately
candidate_rule: pooled enrichment>=2 and target>=100 OR at least one nonreference hap enrichment>=2 and target>=10
count_precision: Jellyfish uint32 per hap; uint64 downstream
preliminary_rule: nonreference pooled target>=100 OR nonreference maximum hap target>=10
background: complement of existing HSat2/3 BED on eligible T2T chromosomes
